description: Hourly Precipitation Observations is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information. From the Hourly/Sub-Hourly Observational Data menu, select data of interest, and then use the map tools to order data. Click the Help link in the upper right to move through the data ordering procedure. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Flooding – Rainfall-induced. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
